title: Conflict-Predictive Variable Horizons in Multi-Drone Distributed Model Predictive Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.13270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In distributed model predictive control for multi-drone collision avoidance, a fixed prediction horizon forces a compromise: a short horizon is inexpensive but reacts late to approaching neighbors, whereas a long one anticipates conflicts at a per-step cost that grows superlinearly with its length. We propose a conflict-predictive variable horizon that each drone sets locally, leaving the distributed model predictive control itself unchanged. From a short history of observed positions, a drone extrapolates the flight lines of its neighbors, tests each against its own using confidence funnels that narrow with prediction range, and obtains each time to conflict in closed form. The horizon is then the smallest admissible value whose planning window covers the farthest predicted conflict. translated_title: 多无人机分布式模型预测控制中的冲突预测变时域方法
translated_abstract: 在用于多无人机避撞的分布式模型预测控制中，固定预测时域迫使一种妥协：短时域计算成本低，但对邻近无人机的接近反应迟缓；长时域能提前预测冲突，但每步计算成本随时域长度呈超线性增长。我们提出一种冲突预测的变时域方法，由每架无人机在本地设置时域，而不改变分布式模型预测控制本身。从一段短暂的观测位置历史中，无人机外推其邻近无人机的飞行路线，利用随预测距离收窄的置信漏斗将其与自身路线逐一比对检验，并以闭式解获得每次冲突发生的时间。随后，时域被设定为能覆盖最远预测冲突的最小可容许值。在空域畅通时，时域收缩至最小值，只有当前方存在冲突时才会增长。只要该最小值满足一个单一的可计算可行性边界（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种冲突预测的变时域方法：每架无人机通过外推邻居飞行轨迹、以置信漏斗检验并以闭式解预测冲突时间，从而在本地自适应调整分布式模型预测控制的预测时域——空域畅通时收缩至最小值、仅在冲突临近时增长，兼顾了计算效率与冲突预见性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a conflict-predictive variable horizon where each drone locally extrapolates neighbors' flight lines and predicts time-to-conflict in closed form, adaptively expanding its distributed MPC horizon only when conflicts lie ahead while collapsing to a minimum in clear airspace.
